prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1058; do not mention it.)
text: Driver 1 was traveling northbound in the left lane of a four-lane roadway in League City, Texas, approaching an intersection with a signalized left-turn arrow. Driver 2 was traveling southbound and attempted a left turn across the path of Driver 1, without yielding the right-of-way. The front driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle struck the front passenger side of Driver 2's vehicle at moderate speed. Both vehicles sustained heavy front-end and side damage and were towed from the scene. A Passenger in Driver 1's vehicle was seated in the rear and was not injured. Driver 1 was conscious and speaking at the scene but reported dizziness, headache, and confusion, and stated they had struck their head on the side window during impact. Emergency medical services evaluated Driver 1 and recommended transport to a local hospital for further evaluation of a possible concussion. Driver 2 was cited for failure to yield the right-of-way when turning left. Weather was clear and the road surface was dry at the time of the collision.
